shared_or_similar_visual_information: Circular marker at the edge of a marked interval or at a point on a plotted trace. Compare the mark at 2 on the number line on the left with the mark at −5 on the number line on the right.
mathematical_meanings: Left image: The displayed set excludes 2 at its lower bound. Right image: The displayed set excludes −5 at its lower bound.
Rationales: On the left, the hollow endpoint marks a strict boundary of the marked ray. On the right, the hollow endpoint marks a strict boundary of the marked ray.
